title: monarda fistulosa subsp. menthifolia
intro: Monarda fistulosa subsp. menthifolia, commonly known as Bee Balm, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and acting as an antiseptic to prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Monarda fistulosa subsp. menthifolia include antiviral, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its ability to combat colds, flu, and other respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Bee Balm include monoterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
